mixed.interpretation: Cold response is identical, but forced long peer continuations differ after early natural stopping points. These numbers are observational scheduling evidence, not a controlled same-output throughput claim or proof of exact DMA/compute overlap. Estimated peer counters conservatively subtract the full cold completion count; first-token accounting and polling boundaries are not isolated.

limits: Single observations per performance case, no confidence interval or general speedup claim.
RTX PRO 6000, Windows, NVFP4 27B + DFlash2 Q3, target int8 KV. No new MTP/TP hardware qualification; these retain Host restoration.
Matrix full-decode rates use native counter intervals where all requested lanes are decoding, excluding cold prefill and the tail.
Matrix document effective input rate divides all document input by batch wall time; it is not per-kernel prefill throughput.
Task2 replays 33 fixed historical requests, not model-generated closed-loop tool arguments. Text/usage/acceptance equivalence is checked, semantic quality is not newly scored.
The no-refresh normalized-output-key observer fixture requires a pre-existing out-of-tree test hook and was not linked into this production binary; the production query/native byte fixtures were run.
Cache-hit policy was intentionally outside scope. Existing 4/8 lane question hit patterns were unchanged.
